rows.note: Use this for modern or contemporary ideas and ways of thinking; it is the all-purpose choice for sense 0.

example.english: Young people nowadays are generally more open to modernism.

rows.note: Use this when referring to the quality or feel that makes something seem modern.

example.english: After replacing the door with a glass one, the shop immediately gained a real sense of modernism.
